title: 第23章 恶魔围城第24章 返回新约城
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 一个月的时间，足以让恐慌，如同瘟疫般在卡兰城内蔓延发酵。
街道上，往日还算熙攘的人群如今行色匆匆，脸上大多带着压抑和不安。
低声的议论如同潮水般在坊间流动，却又被一种无形的恐惧压着音量。
“听说了吗？城外……恶魔越来越多了……”
“峡谷那边的恶魔好像都过来了！我表哥是城墙守卫队的，他说昨天换岗时偷偷往下瞥了一眼，黑压压的一片，根本看不到头！”
“城主府早就下令封锁消息了，还不准冒险家公会发布外出清理任务，这不明摆着出大事了吗？”
“王都来的那些骑士老爷呢？不是去讨伐恶魔了吗？这都一个月了，怎么一点消息都没有？”
“怕是……全折在黑森林里了吧？哎，我就说别去招惹那些传奇恶魔……”
“完了完了……他们肯定是把恶魔惹毛了，现在人家报仇来了！我们怎么办啊？！”
不安和绝望的情绪如同厚重的阴云，笼罩着这座被高墙隔绝的孤城。
哪怕有坚不可摧的巨型城墙守护。
城内的居民也没有丝毫安全感。
所有人都明白，如此数量的恶魔聚集。
绝不可能只是来城外“观光”一圈就离开。
与此同时，不久前，城主送骑士团出征时。
那番慷慨激昂的演说，如今成了最大的讽刺。
被无数人在私下里反复提及并唾弃。
城主府的威望，已然跌落谷底。
城主府内，气氛比街上更加凝滞沉重。
肥胖的城主早已失去了往日的气派。
像一只热锅上的蚂蚁，在铺着华丽地毯的议事厅内来回踱步。
额头上的冷汗擦了又冒，华丽的锦袍都被汗水浸透了一片。
“一万……一万多了……高阶恶魔几千……这怎么守？这怎么守得住啊！”
他嘴里反复念叨着，从城墙守军那里送来的最新报告，声音因为恐惧而颤抖。
他很清楚，卡兰城的城墙或许能挡住地面上的低阶恶魔潮。
但对于那些能飞行的天空恶魔，以及拥有恐怖破坏力的英雄阶恶魔而言。
这高墙形同虚设！
而如今卡兰城的顶级战力，早在之前针对冒险者的阴谋。
损失殆尽，十不存一！
仅靠普通的城防军，根本不可能抵挡得住，城外那如同洪荒巨兽般的恶魔大军！
“怎么办……怎么办……”他几乎要崩溃了。
就在这时，议事厅沉重的大门，被人毫不客气地推开。
一名身着华丽城防长官铠甲、神色倨傲的年轻贵族大步走了进来。
他甚至懒得行礼，直接将一封信函，甩在了城主面前的桌子上。
“城主阁下。”
他的声音带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑。
“这是我的离职信。我的家族已经决定即刻撤离卡兰城，所以，城防军副指挥一职，恕不奉陪了。”
城主如同被踩了尾巴的猫，猛地冲了过去。
竟然不顾形象地一把抱住了贵族城防长官的大腿，声音带着哭腔和哀求：
“不能走！你们不能走啊！鲍勃城防长官！"
"当初是你们！是你们让我想办法削弱那些泥腿子冒险者的！"
content_en:
One month was enough for panic to spread and ferment in Kalan City like a plague.
On the streets, the crowds that used to be bustling are now walking in a hurry, with most of their faces looking depressed and uneasy.
Whispered discussions flowed among the people like a tidal wave, but their volume was suppressed by an invisible fear.
"Have you heard? There are more and more demons outside the city..."
"It seems that all the demons from the other side of the canyon are here! My cousin is in the city wall guard team. He said that he secretly glanced down when the guard was changing yesterday. It was so dark that you couldn't even see the end!"
"The city lord's palace has already issued an order to block the news, and the Adventurer's Guild is not allowed to issue cleanup missions. Doesn't this mean something serious is going on?"
"Where are those knights from the royal capital? Aren't they going to fight against demons? It's been a month, why is there no news at all?"
"Are you afraid that... they are all lost in the dark forest? Hey, I just told you not to provoke those legendary demons..."
"It's over, it's over... They must have pissed off the devil, and now they're out for revenge! What should we do?!"
Uneasiness and despair are like thick clouds, shrouding this isolated city isolated by high walls.
Even if it is protected by an indestructible giant wall.
The residents in the city have no sense of security at all.
Everyone understood that such a large number of demons gathered.
It is absolutely impossible to just come and “go sightseeing” outside the city and then leave.
At the same time, not long ago, the city lord sent the knights on an expedition.
That impassioned speech has now become the greatest irony.
Repeatedly mentioned and spurned by countless people in private.
The prestige of the City Lord's Mansion has fallen to the bottom.
In the city lord's palace, the atmosphere was more stagnant and heavier than on the street.
The fat city lord has long lost his former magnificence.
Like an ant on a hot pot, he paced back and forth in the ornately carpeted chamber.
The cold sweat on his forehead was wiped off again and again, and the gorgeous brocade robe was soaked with sweat.
"Ten thousand...more than ten thousand...thousands of high-level demons...how can we defend this? How can we defend this!"
He kept mumbling the latest report sent from the city wall defenders, his voice trembling with fear.
He knew very well that the walls of Kallan City might be able to block the tide of low-level demons on the ground.
But for those sky demons that can fly, and the hero-level demons with terrifying destructive power.
This high wall is in vain!
And now the top combat power of Kallan City has long been involved in the conspiracy against adventurers.
Total loss, not even one out of ten!
It is simply impossible for ordinary city defense troops to withstand the demon army outside the city that looks like a prehistoric beast!
"What to do... what to do..." He almost collapsed.
At this moment, the heavy door of the conference hall was pushed open unceremoniously.
A young nobleman wearing a gorgeous city defense officer's armor and a haughty look strode in.
He didn't even bother to salute and directly threw a letter on the table in front of the city lord.
"Your Excellency the City Lord."
His voice was laced with undisguised contempt.
"This is my resignation letter. My family has decided to evacuate Kalan City immediately, so I will not be accompanying you as deputy commander of the city defense force."
The city lord rushed over like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
Regardless of his appearance, he hugged the noble city defense officer's thigh, his voice filled with tears and pleading:
"You can't leave! You can't leave! Chief Bob!"
"It was you in the beginning! It was you who asked me to find a way to weaken those mud-legged adventurers!"
